svg.text: WALL KINDS: FOUR TABLES OF 70 ENTRIES, INDEXED BY THE BYTE IN THE MAZE
what a click or a hit does: 0
Kinds 0 to 22 are built in. DefineWallType (ovl3:01C8) sets the kinds a level file names, from a 5-byte record:
kind, picture set, decoration, handler, flags. The file's flag byte f is stored as f ^ 4: bit 2 means 'blocks monsters' in the file.
THE FLAG BITS (GWALLTYPEFLAGS), AND WHERE THE CODE TESTS THEM
the party can walk through; a thrown item passes
small things pass or see through (bars): items of icon size 15 or more
a door (set on side 0 when the door lies north to south)
a door in its last 'open' frame
a door in its first 'closed' frame
(only kind 2 has it; no code tests it)
not a plain wall face: floor items and flying objects are drawn in the cell
THE BUILT-IN KINDS 0 TO 24: FLAGS (HEX) AS THE PROGRAM CARRIES THEM
A door is five kinds in a row: closed (A8), three opening frames (88), open (9F). C and D carry bit 1 as well (AA, 8A): small things pass the bars
even when closed. Handler 1 (door button) sits on every frame of A and C, handler 6 (cannot be pried) on the closed frame of B and D. The level
files redefine 23 and 24 and add kinds up to 69.
